column3: up with the pace-setter early - sent to the front soon after - the margin over the field shrank 3f out - reeled in and passed 1f out - responded to retake the front and found extra in a driving finish

handy early - eased back into the pack soon after - 3rd at halfway - up to 2nd 2 1/2f out - went past the pace-setter for a slender advantage 1f out - overtaken near the line but battled on to finish 2nd beaten half a length

started towards the back - 6th at halfway - up to 5th 3f out - pushed forward into 4th 2f out - made ground out wide to be 3rd over 1f out - unable to get nearer the front runners and held a steady gear to the line

a shade slow to begin - settled at the back - 5th at halfway - slipped to 6th 3f out - made no dent on the front runners 2f out - found a new gear to reach 5th over 1f out and held a steady stride through the last furlong for 4th near the finish

held a spot towards the back of the pack - 4th at halfway - up to 3rd 2 1/2f out - slipped back to 4th and was driven along over 1f out - found nothing more in the final furlong and gave way to finish 5th near the line

went in front by a short margin - was overtaken soon after - 2nd at halfway - closed the gap on the front-runners 3f out - was soon driven along and began to slip back 2 1/2f out - made no dent in 5th 2f out - faded into 6th over 1f out
settled last early and made headway before the 16th - improved into third before 2 out - pushed into second before the last - kept on well to get up and win close home
well positioned early - untidy 3 out - hit the front approaching 2 out - driven before the last and urged run-in - held on but no match for the winner and was overtaken towards the finish
settled towards the back early and made ground before the 16th - up to third by 4 out - driven 2 out - made no impact when tested at the last
set the pace early - came under pressure after 3 out before being passed approaching 2 out - found nothing more and beaten into fourth
settled at the back - urged for effort 4 out - dropped away 3 out
close to the pace early but drifted right over the fences - slipped back at the 14th - driven at the following fence - faded from 3 out
travelled in the pack and jumped high at the 3rd - up to third by the 14th - faded softly after 4 out
Never in the front rank early - close up and pushed along with 2f left - made ground into the last furlong - found extra to hit the front close home
Handy in the pack early - angled right and pushed along with 2f left - battled to the front approaching the last furlong - stayed on but caught close home
Raced close to the pace - hit the front after a furlong - disputing the advantage with 2f left - lost the front and slipped to third close home

Pulling hard in the early stages - racing in the pack - shifted left and pushed along with 2f left before angling right entering the last furlong - up into fourth inside the final 110 yards and quickest through the closing stages
Quick into stride to make the running - surrendered that spot after a furlong then pushed along in pursuit with 2f left - soon dropped away
Racing in the pack - pushed along and made a little progress with 2f left - soon lost ground
Pulling hard in the early stages - off the pace throughout
Close up early - pushed along and dropped back with 2f left - soon faded
in rear early - error at the 4th - awkward 6th - further error 2 out - driven out to get up close home
tracked in second - hit the front before 4th - driven before last and caught close home
held up in rear - moved into second before 3 out - driven before last - dropped that spot and found no more in the run-in
set the pace - overtaken before 4th - driven and dropped back before 3 out - toiling after 2 out and soon well held

soon up with the pace - 3rd at halfway - moved smoothly into command 2f out - was challenged hard and lost that spot 1f out - fought back to regain the front by a short margin in the final 100 yards and found the most in a driving finish

started towards the back of the pack - made ground after 1f - 4th at halfway - closed in on the front-runners 2f out - went past the pace-setter into the front 1f out - was overtaken in the final 100 yards - battled to the line but was narrowly denied in 2nd

started towards the back of the field - slipped back to 8th at halfway - made strong late progress inside 2f out - up to 3rd over 1f out - stayed on strongly through the final furlong and was going best of all at the line
soon sat behind the front-runner - a shade free early - 2nd at halfway - slipped back 2f out - made no dent in 5th inside the final furlong and held a single gear to take 4th near the finish
settled in the pack - slipped to 6th at halfway - narrowed the gap over 2f out to be 4th but made no dent 1f out - faded back to 5th and found little more near the finish
soon went to the front and travelled keenly early - was driven along and overtaken 2f out then dropped back after being lightly hampered 1 1/2f out - gave way inside the final furlong
started at the back - 7th at halfway - made no dent on the front runners inside 2f out and found nothing more over 1f out
started towards the back - made ground to race 5th at halfway - slipped back to the tail of the field and was driven along 2f out before fading in the final furlong
up with the pace early and settled behind the front-runner after the 2nd - untidy 4 out - made ground after 3 out - moved to the front before 2 out - soon opened a big gap - scored readily

set the pace and opened a gap after the 2nd - blundered at the 6th - fluffed 3 out and saw the advantage cut - asked for more before being overtaken before 2 out - responded but unable to live with the winner
settled behind the pace early and sketchy at the 2nd - in the pack by the 5th - driven after 3 out - battled on - without threatening the front
in the pack early and up to third by the 5th - driven after 3 out - well held and slipped back before the last
at the back throughout - beaten into fifth
settled at the back - driven 4 out - found nothing and pulled up after 3 out
In command from the outset - pushed along with 3f left - shifted right when niggled along with 1f left - stayed on to narrowly prevail at the line
Tracked the leader early - pushed along with 3f left before angling right under renewed effort with 1f left - stayed on but unable to reel in the winner close home
Racing in the pack early - pushed along in close order on the leading group with 2f left - edged right and up into third entering the last furlong then held that spot to the line
Handy early - pushed along with 2f left - drifted left and dropped out of third entering the last furlong before staying on at one speed
Close up early - pushed along with 3f left - up into third with 2f left - edged right and found running room tight with 1f left then unable to fight back
Never troubled the leading group throughout
Racing in the pack - pushed along with 3f left - soon dropped away
Never involved in the finish
held up in rear - nudged along before 6th - improved into second 2 out - went to the front after 2 out - driven further ahead before last and kept on well
held up in rear - driven into third after 2 out - moved into second in the run-in but never able to challenge the winner
up with the pace in second - went to the front after 7th before being driven and passed after 2 out - dropped that spot with nothing more to offer in the run-in
set the pace early - overtaken after 7th - driven and slipped to last after 2 out and soon struggling in rear

started at the back - 6th at halfway - angled left and pushed along 1 1/2f out - made ground out wide to be 4th 1f out - finished strongly in 3rd over the final 150 yards to hit the front near the line and found the most
driven forward into command early - overtaken after 2 1/2f - 2nd at halfway - regained a slim advantage over 3f out - was passed again near the finish but stayed on to the line
started towards the back - settled at the tail of the pack after 1f - 4th at halfway - angled right over 2f out - made ground to be 3rd inside 2f out and held a steady gear to the finish
began towards the back of the field - 5th at halfway - up to 2nd 1f out and drifted right - faded to 4th near the finish and held one steady gear
sat behind the pace-setter early - went in front after 2 1/2f - overtaken over 3f out - slipped to 5th and lightly hampered 1f out - made no dent on the front and was allowed to coast home

sat behind the pace-setter early - settled in the pack after 1f - 3rd at halfway - 4th inside 2f out - slipped to 6th and was hampered 1f out - soon lost ground and was taken along steadily to the finish
settled behind the pace - asked for effort and hit the front 2 out - drifted left and untidy at the last - stayed on run-in to win
settled in the pack - made ground before 4 out - driven up to second before 2 out - under continued pressure but found no extra run-in
up with the pace and in behind the front-runner by the 4th - made ground after 3 out - driven to the front on the home turn before 2 out where overtaken - weakened approaching the last
in front but harried early and soon opened a gap after the 3rd - untidy at the 4th - saw the advantage cut after 3 out - overtaken on the home turn before 2 out - faded
in the pack early and up to third by the 4th - slipped back 3 out - soon beaten
at the back - driven 3 out - found nothing
at the back - driven 3 out and well beaten
prominent on the outside and in behind the front runners by the 3rd - faded fast 4 out - pulled up after the following fence
Pulling hard in the early stages - tracked the pace - made ground to hit the front with 2f left - pushed along and stayed on but was fully tested to the line
Racing in the pack early - pushed along with 2f left - closed in on the winner and stayed on through the final furlong - went right up to the winner but unable to pass close home
Held up towards the back early - pushed along with 2f left - up into third entering the last furlong and stayed on at one speed
In front early - pushed along and lost that spot with 2f left - faded to last entering the final furlong
led from the start - driven and challenged before last - stayed on to win
up with the leaders - driven and dropped back before last - responded after last to hold second
up with the pace - driven before 2 out - chased the winner after 2 out - awkward at the last but stayed on for third
held up in fourth - pushed along after 2 out - moved into third before last but relinquished that spot with nothing more to offer in the run-in
pulled hard in a handy position early - driven after 2 out - never landed a blow
soon went to the front - dictated the running from there - was challenged over 1f out - pulled clear again in the final 150 yards and finished strongly
began towards the back of the pack - slipped to 5th at halfway - made ground in 4th over 1f out - ran on well in 3rd and grabbed 2nd near the line but couldn't reach the winner

sat behind the front-runner - 2nd at halfway - pushed to get on terms with the one up front over 1f out - made no dent on the one in front in the final 150 yards - held a steady gear but slipped to 3rd near the finish
started towards the back - made ground to race 4th at halfway - narrowed in to be 3rd 2f out - made no dent on the front runners 1f out then faded back to 4th holding a steady gear to the finish
settled in the pack - 3rd at halfway - slipped to 4th 2f out - made no dent in 5th over 1f out and held a steady gear to the finish
started at the back - 6th at halfway - began dropping away from the field over 2f out - soon in trouble and was pulled up inside 2f out
settled behind the pace - in the pack by the 7th - up to third by the 12th - driven and hit the front after 3 out - opened a big advantage after 2 out - stayed on with plenty in hand
close to the pace early - mistake at the 4th and slipped back - towards the back by the 6th and under pressure by the 11th - battled on with resolve - grabbed second close home
up with the pace on the outside - hit the front by the 12th - driven after 4 out before being overtaken after 3 out - found nothing more 2 out
in front early before being overtaken by the 12th and driven - stayed close to the pace - driven again after 4 out and soon lost place
in the pack early and up to fourth by the 7th - driven 4 out - soon well held
at the back early and driven at the 7th - driven again by the 9th and found nothing - eventually pulled up before 3 out
struggling at the back of the field throughout - pulled up after the 4th
settled in behind the pace before dropping back and being driven by the 12th - well beaten from 4 out - pulled up after the following fence

Cruising through the early stages towards the back - made steady progress to close on the front-runner entering the final furlong - quickened into command and shot away - was never seriously challenged to the line
Untidy start - close up on the front group - pushed along to hit the front after 2f then had to fight to hold that spot entering the final furlong - soon overtaken and outrun towards the line
Pulling hard early - settled towards the back - made ground with 2f left - pushed along and looking a threat - dropped out of second entering the last furlong and stayed on at one speed
Pulling hard early - racing in the pack - pushed along with 2f left but unable to make any inroads with 1f left
Pulling hard early - racing close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left before fading with 1f left
Pulling hard early - racing in the pack - slipped towards the back with 3f left - angled right and pushed along with 1f left then soon faded
In front early - pushed along with 2f left - soon overtaken and dropped away
held up in fourth - driven and improved after 2 out - hit the front before last and drew away in the run-in
pulled hard early and set the pace - opened up an advantage after 5th - that advantage shrank before 3 out - driven and overtaken before last - stayed on but never threatened the winner
up in third early - serious mistake 2 out - soon driven and unable to improve before last
up with the front-runner - narrowed the gap before 3 out - driven after 2 out and faded at the last
in rear from the start - toiling 3 out - far behind at the finish
sat behind the pace-setter - 2nd at halfway - narrowed the gap 1f out - went to the front in the final 150 yards and finished strongly

started towards the back - slipped to 7th at halfway - made ground inside 2f out - up to 3rd inside the final furlong - finished well to grab 2nd near the line but couldn't get competitive with the winner
away smartly to the front - stretched clear after 1 1/2f - the margin came back 1f out - was passed in the final 150 yards - unable to get competitive with the winner and slipped to 3rd near the line
soon settled in the pack out wide - up to 3rd after 2f - made no dent on the front runners 1f out - soon slipped to 4th and found little more near the finish
soon settled towards the back of the pack - 6th at halfway - pushed along into 5th 1 1/2f out - made no dent and found little extra inside the final furlong
started at the back - made ground to race 5th at halfway - made no dent in 6th inside 2f out and gave way over 1f out
in contention early - up in 4th after 2f - slipped to the back 3f out and was pulled up over 2f out
settled behind the pace and sluggish at the 1st - driven before 2 out - driven up to challenge after 2 out - found extra to edge in front close home

in front early and veered right over obstacles for most of the way - driven before 2 out and veered right again - came under attack after 2 out - kept finding more - overtaken by a short margin close home
in behind the front runners - driven before 2 out - kept on at an even gallop
in the pack - made ground before 2 out to move into fourth - found no more from there
at the back early - driven 4 out - battled on but unable to get involved
up with the pace - driven before 2 out - soon faded
in the pack - driven and dropped away after 3 out
at the back - driven 4 out and well beaten
Racing in the pack early - made ground and looked the strongest with 2f left - pushed along to hit the front with 1f left and stayed on strongly to the line
In front early - pushed along with 2f left - overtaken with 1f left and soon outrun
Tracked the pace early - pushed along with 2f left - soon dropped out of second and faded
Never landed a blow
up with the pace - went to the front after 2 out - driven before last and drew well away after
up with the pace group - pressed forward after 2 out - driven before last - second at the line but no answer to the winner
racing in mid-division - driven after 2 out - a modest third without threatening
settled in behind - pushed along after 2 out - soon under pressure and made a mistake at the last
racing in mid-division - toiling after 2 out - never threatened
settled towards the rear - lost contact from 6th - always struggling to play a part
drifted right early and set the pace - driven and overtaken after 2 out - responded to challenge the winner before last but stumbled and was pulled up
handy early - soon went to the front - tried to go further clear over 1f out - found the most through the final furlong though the margin came back near the finish

away smartly to the front - was soon passed and travelled keenly - in contention after 1f - 4th at halfway - narrowed the gap into 3rd over 2f out - up to 2nd over 1f out - stayed on to the finish and clung on for 2nd

a shade slow to begin - handy out wide soon after - sat behind the pace-setter after 1f - 2nd at halfway - slipped to 3rd over 1f out - stayed on through the final furlong but made no dent on the front runners near the finish

a shade slow to begin - soon settled towards the back of the pack - 6th at halfway - pushed along 1 1/2f out - made ground inside the final furlong to hold 4th near the finish and never landed a serious blow
handy early - 3rd at halfway - down to 4th over 2f out - was driven along 1 1/2f out and held a steady gear in 5th near the finish
started at the back - was pushed up to race 9th at halfway - improved into 8th over 1f out - finished well through the final furlong to take 6th near the line
soon settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - driven along in 6th over 1f out - held a steady gear through the final furlong then found little more near the line in 7th
handy early - soon taken in hand - slipped towards the back and was pushed to keep up after 1 1/2f - 7th at halfway - faded to 9th 2f out then settled into a steady gear in 8th near the finish
started towards the back - 8th at halfway - pushed into 7th 2f out - made no dent over 1f out - faded back to the tail of the field near the finish and soon found little more

eager early and in front - overtaken after the 3rd - stayed close to the pace - driven and back in front before 2 out - opened a big advantage and drifted right over the last two flights - scoring with authority
close up behind the front-runner and edged in front after the 3rd - untidy 3 out - driven and overtaken before 2 out - battled on but unable to trouble the winner
settled behind the pace on the inside and up to second by 4 out - driven after 3 out and lost place - steadied down before the last
at the back - untidy at the 1st - dropped away 3 out
in behind the pace and green over the obstacles for most of the way - driven 4 out - soon well beaten - eventually pulled up before 2 out
Pulling hard early - close up on the pack - made steady progress with 2f left - soon pushed along to hit the front - stayed on through the last furlong to score narrowly
Shared the front early - went on alone with 3f left - soon pushed along - overtaken with 2f left and outrun entering the final furlong - responded for the finish but unable to reel in the winner
Shared the front early - overtaken with 3f left - pushed along and outrun with 2f left before responding to claim third towards the finish

Close up towards the back early - angled right and pushed along with 2f left - soon in pursuit of the front group - stayed on at one speed through the last furlong before dropping out of third towards the finish
Pulling hard early - close up towards the back - pushed along with 3f left before fading with 2f left
Jinked left at the off and pulled hard in the early stages - never troubled the leaders
settled in rear - moved up into third before 4 out - progressed into second before 2 out - driven to the front before last and ran on strongly
settled towards the rear - pushed along after 4 out - moved into third before last and grabbed second close home
set the pace - driven and overtaken before last - found nothing more in the run-in and relinquished second close home
up in third - moved into second by the 8th - driven and headed before 2 out after a mistake and soon faded
up with the pace - slipped back by the 8th - fell to last before 4 out and was pulled up before 3 out

slow to begin - settled at the back - still towards the back after 3f - holding 6th 4f out - made ground 2f out - up to 3rd inside 2f out - 2nd 1f out - went to the front in the final 150 yards - went clear near the finish for an easy win
handy early - soon went to the front - driven along 1f out - passed in the final 150 yards - stayed on near the finish but couldn't get competitive with the winner
settled in the pack - up in 3rd 4f out - slipped to 4th and was pushed for a response inside 2f out - angled left over 1f out and stayed on through the final furlong to reclaim 3rd near the finish

away smartly to the front - was soon passed and settled behind the new pace-setter - up in 2nd 4f out - still holding a threat in 3rd 1f out - made no dent on the front runners near the finish and slipped to 4th at the line
started at the back - down in 7th 4f out - pushed along over 1f out where briefly short of room - angled right in 5th inside the final furlong and held a steady gear to the finish
sat behind the pace-setter - slipped to 4th 4f out - made no dent in 5th 2f out and gave way in 6th inside the final furlong
began towards the back of the pack - down in 5th 4f out - driven along in 6th 2f out and gave way in the final furlong
Pulling hard early - shared the front - went on alone with 3f left - shaken up with 2f left and stayed on strongly from over 1f out
Racing in the pack early - pushed along and made ground with 2f left - shared second with 1f left then in pursuit of the winner - unable to live with the winner in the final 110 yards

Pulling hard early - racing in the pack - pushed along with 3f left - found running room restricted with 2f left - made ground to share second with 1f left but soon found nothing more and dropped out of that spot
Sluggish start - pushed along towards the back early - made ground with 2f left - close up on the front group but drifted right with 1f left - stayed on to finish fastest of all
Never travelling fluently in the pack early - close up on the front group with 2f left - shared second with 1f left - dropped away in the final 110 yards
Settled towards the back early - pushed along with 3f left - angled right with 2f left - stayed on from over 1f out but never a threat up front
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - made ground with 3f left - soon pushed along and faded in the final furlong
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - pushed along with 3f left before angling right with 2f left - made a little late progress with 1f left
Pulling hard early - racing in the pack - dropped a place and pushed along with 3f left - unable to make any impact with 1f left
Racing close to the pace - pushed along with 2f left - soon dropped away
Never travelling fluently - close up on the front group - faded from 3f out
Shared the front early - pushed along and overtaken with 3f left - faded with 2f left
Close up early - pushed along and dropped a place with 3f left - soon faded
led from the start - driven further ahead in the run-in - won with something in hand
up with the pace - driven in pursuit of the winner after 2 out - stayed on but unable to get on terms
up in third early - lost touch with the front pair from the 2nd - always struggling to get involved
in rear from the start - lost touch from the 2nd - always struggling to play a part
a shade slow to begin - soon settled towards the back of the stand-rail bunch - angled right and made ground over 1f out - narrowed the gap in the final 100 yards and went on to score near the finish

started towards the back of the far-rail bunch - made ground inside 2f out - up to 2nd inside the final 100 yards - went to the front for a moment near the finish - stayed on but was overtaken right at the line

soon went in front of the far-rail bunch and the entire field - stretched the margin inside 2f out - the gap came back inside the final furlong - was fully extended and overtaken near the finish then slipped to 3rd at the line
a shade slow to begin - soon sat behind the front-runner of the stand-rail bunch - narrowed in to 2nd inside the final furlong - faded to 4th near the finish holding a steady gear to the line
sat behind the front-runner of the far-rail bunch - pushed along and made ground 1f out - faded to 5th near the finish holding a steady gear
soon went in front of the stand-rail bunch - slipped back inside 2f out - was driven along in 7th inside the final furlong and held a steady gear to finish 6th near the line
in contention within the stand-rail bunch - made ground inside 2f out - slipped back in the final 150 yards and found little more near the finish
in contention within the far-rail bunch - slipped towards the back before halfway - made no dent 1f out and gave way in the final 150 yards
handy down the middle of the course - slipped back inside 2f out - made no dent and gave way over 1f out
a shade slow to begin - settled towards the back of the stand-rail bunch - made no dent 1 1/2f out and gave way in the final furlong
slow away from the stalls - settled at the back - lost touch with the field after 1f - unable to make any ground - gave way inside 2f out and was always held off the pace
